meta.name: init-deep
meta.description: Initializes a hierarchical AGENTS.md knowledge base for a project. Use when a repo needs its structure, commands, and conventions documented for agents.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把项目结构、命令与规范沉淀成分级指南,让 AI 代理快速理解代码库
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让 AI 编程助手准确理解你的项目结构和开发约定。
copy.tagline_en: Turn repo structure, commands, and conventions into a layered guide for AI agents.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want AI coding agents to understand your project's structure, commands, and conventions.

howto.what: 为项目生成分层的 AGENTS.md 知识库:先扫描目录结构和代码符号,给各目录打分,再在根目录与得分高的子目录写下结构、命令和约定说明。
howto.when: 当你运行 /init-deep 命令时接管,或当仓库需要把结构、命令和约定记录下来给 agent 用时触发。

say.note: 更新已有 AGENTS.md,并在需要处新建
先读现有内容,再删除并按当前结构重新生成
把扫描的目录深度限制在 2 层

howto.what_en: Generates a hierarchical AGENTS.md knowledge base: it scans directory structure and code symbols, scores each directory, then writes structure, commands, and conventions into the root and high-scoring subdirectories.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you run the /init-deep command, or when a repo needs its structure, commands, and conventions documented for agents.

say_en.note: Updates existing AGENTS.md and creates new ones where warranted
Reads existing files, removes them, regenerates from scratch
Limits scanned directory depth to 2 levels
